projects.name: Thailand manufacturing facility expansion
projects.quote: Our capital expenditures for 2025 were $201.2 million (2024 — $170.9 million; 2023 — $125.1 million), primarily to enhance our manufacturing capabilities in various geographies (including expansion of our Thailand, U.S. and Malaysia manufacturing facilities and our design centers), in support of our growth in AI/ML and HPS programs.
